game_title: Type Cast Forge – Cinder Cone Camp Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the forge_heat value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about forge_heat to power up the fire warden and open the cooling vent.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how forge_heat changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
